body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 17:17Z). The global 64-slot named-root table fills because completed items keep their naming. A completed item cannot be own-cleared (claim recovery is refused), so only w-52222f575b81's audited release can free it.

RULE for every lane and every train:
- After the item's credited checks and evaluation PASS, and BEFORE `done`, while the claim is live, make ONE own-clear: termal_name_source_root(work=<item>), path omitted.
- Then `done`. For train members, only after the push.

Today's stuck examples: w-44a9, completed by Merger at 17:07Z with its naming kept; w-b201 (BarA1 g784); train-2's w-89ea and w-9fdf.

There is no read-only root listing API until w-52222 lands. A 409 body lists only project, work, generation and reason. CheckIn builds inventories from 409 bodies plus Engram show.
